scope: EXT-F-1004-T05 member warm Identity field acceptance on frozen development artifact 0.2.189
cause: The acceptance driver clicked the center of Chromium's segmented native date input and sent the whole ISO date through Input.insertText. The Birthday control remained unchanged; the preceding six Identity text fields reached their individual fill assertions. This is a test driver defect, not evidence of a Profile product failure.
repair: The driver now targets the month segment and sends trusted digit key events for Birthday. Field failures report only a fixed phase, field name and match boolean. If restoration also fails, the original field error remains primary and the cleanup failure is attached separately.
local_verification: A focused Chromium date-control probe showed the old center-click plus text insertion left the value empty; month-segment click plus digit key events produced the ISO date. The same key sequence cleared an existing date and set the target date. Thirteen focused tests and TypeScript compile passed.
